These frames are designed to turn your Springfield XD-M 45ACP parts kits back into functional firearms. YAY! 

The main frame was edited from the work of 458SOCOM (THE XD KING) Be sure to thank 458SOCOM for his hard work in making these a reality!

XD-M Vs Standard XD:
The main difference in this newer pistol is the auto takedown feature. This allows you to take the gun down without pulling the trigger. Additionally, this frame will also work with the slides from XD-M Elite models. This means if you can find a 10mm slide, it will work without modification on this frame. This frame WILL NOT work with the Elite trigger group. The XD-M uses the same mags as the XD in 45!
